# Offline GLB loader

`GLTFLoader.js` and `BufferGeometryUtils.js` are from Three.js r160 (`examples/jsm`), MIT licensed, copyright Three.js Authors. The existing Three.js core and other addons in `index.html` are also r160. Run `node scripts/embed-gltf-loader.mjs` after changing either loader source; this puts the modules into the page import map so opening `index.html` from a local file remains possible.

Three.js license: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r160/LICENSE
